Why did the FAA ground stop happen, and is it over? As of Fri Nov 13, 2026, 9 pm ET: the nationwide stop on departures was lifted around 8:15 pm ET, Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy said, more than four hours after it began. Nearly 5,000 flights were cancelled, ABC News reports. Duffy pointed to inconsistency in data from routers in what he called an incredibly old air traffic control system; the FAA has described a temporary telecommunications outage. CBS News, citing sources, reported that a network update made the system reboot and crash; that is not confirmed. Homeland Security Secretary Markwayne Mullin said there was no indication yet of a nefarious act.
